content.value: A structural component made of aluminium alloy is subjected to tensile load of 50, (10) 000 N. The cross-sectional area of the component is $2 5 \mathrm { m m } ^ { 2 } .$ Determine whether it is safe to use if the yield strength of the alloy is 200 MPa.
